notes.title: 5.17update
notes.content:
1.Added vision system: Units outside the line of sight of allied forces will no longer be displayed. Vision range is now a frontal cone-shaped sector for each unit.

2.Adjusted AI to better adapt to vision system: Units with attack range exceeding their lock-on radius can now perform over-the-horizon attacks on spotted targets.

3.Revised player lock-on system: Locking now directly targets unit instead of predictive aiming (as pre-aiming becomes irrelevant at effective lock distances and caused erratic vision shifts/missed attacks).

4.Added elemental system: Magic attacks now inflict Light, Dark, Water, Fire, Earth, and Wind attributes. Each element has unique effects and amplified damage against countered elements (Light > Dark > [all subordinate elements] > Water > Fire > Earth > Wind). Elemental reactions can only trigger once every 3 seconds.

5.Introduced damage-type: Damage is categorized as Armor-Piercing, Energy, and Blunt. Energy ignores armor but suffers double defense reduction, while Blunt ignores defense but is reduced by armor value.

6.Improved melee animations for better hit reliability (affects both allies and enemies) and optimized melee visual effects.

7.Enhanced night scene lighting to make shadow areas visible.

8.Fixed multiplayer bug where rooms persisted after host departure: New players now automatically become hosts and can start games normally.

9.Increased cooldown and mana cost for Ice Mages' mana regeneration skills to prevent invincibility loops with multiple Ice Mages.

notes.title: October 7 update: New tactical command mode and new optional character added
notes.content:
Content Update:

1.Added a tactical command mode, allowing victory by commanding squad-level troops to capture points.
2.Introduced new warrior-type optional characters with powerful support skills.
3.Added a new boss:Patchouli.

Optimization Update:

1.Modified action logic to make attack wind-up and recovery more intuitive
2.Improved the display of the mini-map (in levels with mini-maps) to indicate the direction characters are facing.
3.Changed melee logic so interrupted enemies no longer register melee damage.
4.Reduced stamina recovery speed, minimizing excessive movement from AI enemies.
5.Increased cooldown and action duration for basic ranged weapons to prevent overwhelming firepower and to make ranged attacks more strategic.

Bug Fixes:

1.Fixed pathfinding AI to better navigate right-angled terrain.
2.Resolved an issue with the mage character's magic shield, allowing it to block attacks exceeding its max HP(but not exceeding HP + MP value).
3.Corrected instances where AI ignored player attacks while performing certain tasks.
4.Fixed AI locking onto players when hit by extremely long-range attacks.

notes.title: UPDATE2024.5.16
notes.content:
-Replaced the previous story mode (taking into account quality issues with the old story mode content).
-The new story mode will periodically update maps and plot based on mea's livestream. This issue features miscellaneous discussions about Mud Dumplings.
-The old story mode can still be accessed through saved files, and based on feedback, entry points may be reintroduced.
-Added new bosses, Remilia and Sakuya.

-The new aiming system is now tied to weapons and skills. Melee attacks are fixed to lock-on, while ranged attacks are fixed to aim-down-sights.
-Increased lock-on distance significantly, limited to enemy units only.
-Different magnification levels added to the aim-down-sights mode, with higher magnification for longer-range skills.
-The crosshair changes to a more favorable style for aiming when using the aiming mode.
-Optimized the AI of summons, they will now automatically perform the same tasks as their summoners.
-Improved shooting logic, short cooldown shooting has been changed to full auto mode (continuous firing while holding down the button).

-Fixed an issue with the Necromancer's summon skeleton skill not working in any mode.
-Fixed an issue where enemies could continue attacking in unbalanced mode.
-Fixed an issue with the Archer's inaccurate aiming (outlined arrow technique).
-Fixed an issue where some units wouldn't return to their default tasks after losing their target.
-Fixed an issue where backstabbing attacks still considered armor.

notes.title: UPDATE 2024.1.13
notes.content:
Increased the HP of Mea and most Mage bosses.
Increased the stable value of all boss units and decreased the stable value of some minions.
Strengthened Mea`s melee attack power and ability to break stable.

Mea will no longer be interrupted by attacks when its stable value is not 0
Added animation for ranged attacks penetrating obstacles.
Now only ranged attacks with strong armor-piercing abilities can penetrate obstacles, instead of being determined by probability.
Ranged attacks that penetrate obstacles will experience range attenuation and trajectory deviation, and the lower the armor-piercing ability, the greater the impact.

Fixed the issue where characters could pass through obstacles when the frame rate was unstable.
Fixed the issue in English mode where some skills couldn't be correctly obtained.
Fixed the issue where bosses would sometimes leave the boss battlefield on their own.

notes.title: Update12.24
notes.content: Completely removed friendly fire.

notes.title: Update 12.23
notes.content:
1.Added right-click lock on to adapt to fast-paced melee combat, and the default aiming mode for mea will be changed to lock-on.
   You can switch between lock-on and snipe modes in the skill-switching buildings.
2.Redesigned the long-range attack system, including adding recoil and making projectile speed more like FPS games.
   Weapons outside of beams can pivot during firing actions to create a smoother shooting experience.
3.After the reset of the long-range system, the drone squad became excessively powerful, so it will reduced from 4 units per squad to 2.
4.Added prompts for each facility in the defense mode.
5.Corrected the targeting method of enemy pumpkins in defense mode, allowing the fireball rain to accurately target distant foes.
6.Limited the frequency of enemy BOSS dashing. Now, when the enemy BOSS dashes, it will consume stamina just like the player, and after running out of stamina, it will be unable to dash or teleport.

notes.title: Update on October 1st
notes.content:
1.Rebalanced the data, so a normal level player can clear rouge mode.
2.Updated the AI of the boss, now it can recognize the player's behavior and react accordingly.
3.Replaced with higher precision materials.
4.Enhanced the visual effects of the graphics.
5.Updated the motion system to make the actions more natural and fluent.
6.Optimized the lighting effects and reduced the computational cost of the lighting.

notes.title: August 27th Update Instructions
notes.content:
The game language options have been expanded to include English.
Simplified the puzzle of the stage 5; puzzle hints are now scattered around the church, and switches correspond to the color of the hints.
Added a mini-map for multiplayer mode.
Enhanced the dynamic effects of plants.
Fixed the issue of excessive lighting in certain maps.
Significantly shortened the vulnerability time after attacks (no sudden death).
Optimized the instructional text for the defense mode facility, no longer enigmatic.
Optimized the formation of soldiers, with the middle unit as the reference point for the formation.
Reduced the number of knights per team to 4 instead of 6.

首先预告一下下次更新:

关于游戏的发展方向:
1.游戏会长期更新
2.日常更新为BUG修复和优化
3.会根据咩咩的直播内容不定期添加新的剧情/敌人/场景
4.会不定期进行大更新增加新的玩法,取决于我想玩什么w
5.会不定期的进行画面提升
6.有的时候会添加一些AI实验用BOSS,请不要在意
7.游戏玩法可能会发生改变,但已有功能不会减少
